-- Anti-Tamper & Function Integrity Guard
do
  local _pcall = pcall
  local _type = type
  local _assert = assert
  local _string_byte = string.byte
  local _table_concat = table.concat

  -- Verify core primitives have not been redirected or replaced by executor hooks
  local function _verify_native(f)
    if _type(f) ~= "function" then return false end
    if debug and debug.info then
      local src = debug.info(f, "s")
      if src and src ~= "[C]" and src ~= "=[C]" and not src:find("builtin") then
        return false
      end
    end
    return true
  end

  if not _verify_native(_pcall) or not _verify_native(_string_byte) then
    -- Stealth crash: infinite loop or corrupted stack without clear error message
    local crash; crash = function() return crash() end
    crash()
  end
end

-- Anti-Hooking & Metatable Interception Trap
do
  local _grm = getrawmetatable or debug.getmetatable
  local _srm = setrawmetatable or debug.setmetatable
  local _hook = hookfunction or replaceclosure

  -- If an executor attempts to hook metamethods on the current thread, trigger memory corruption decoy
  if _grm then
    local test_t = {}
    local mt = { __index = function() return 1 end }
    if _srm then
      _srm(test_t, mt)
      local retrieved = _grm(test_t)
      if retrieved ~= mt and type(retrieved) == "table" and retrieved.__index == nil then
        while true do end
      end
    end
  end
end

local _SEED_K = 199
local _SEED_STEP = 17

if not (((19 * 0) == 0)) then while true do end end

local function __decrypt_table(cipher_blob, k1, k2, step)
  local result = {}
  local buffer = {}
  local buf_idx = 1
  local cur_key = k1
  local len = #cipher_blob
  local bit_xor = (bit32 and bit32.bxor) or (bit and bit.bxor) or function(a, b)
    local p, c = 1, 0
    while a > 0 and b > 0 do
      local ra, rb = a % 2, b % 2
      if ra ~= rb then c = c + p end
      a, b, p = (a - ra) / 2, (b - rb) / 2, p * 2
    end
    if a < b then a = b end
    while a > 0 do
      local ra = a % 2
      if ra > 0 then c = c + p end
      a, p = (a - ra) / 2, p * 2
    end
    return c
  end

  for i = 1, len do
    local b = string.byte(cipher_blob, i)
    if b == 255 then
      table.insert(result, table.concat(buffer))
      buffer = {}
      buf_idx = 1
      cur_key = k1
    else
      local plain = bit_xor(bit_xor(b, secondary_key or k2), cur_key) % 256
      buffer[buf_idx] = string.char(plain)
      buf_idx = buf_idx + 1
      cur_key = (cur_key + step) % 256
    end
  end
  return result
end

do local _v = math.floor(0.4384 * 100) end

local function __LUAUSHIELD_VM_ENTRY(__BYTECODE, __CONSTANTS, __PROTOS, ...)
  local _ENV = (getfenv and getfenv()) or _G
  local _VARARGS = { ... }
  local _INSTR = __BYTECODE
  local _CONST = __CONSTANTS
  local _PROTOS = __PROTOS or {}
  local _IP = 1
  local _R = {}
  local _TOP = 0

  -- Dynamic Instruction Dispatcher
  while _IP <= #_INSTR do
    local inst = _INSTR[_IP]
    local op = inst[1]
    local a = inst[2]
    local b = inst[3]
    local c = inst[4]
    _IP = _IP + 1

    if op == 10 then
      -- OP_LOADK: R[a] = Constants[b]
      _R[a] = _CONST[b]
    elseif op == 11 then
      -- OP_GETGLOBAL: R[a] = _ENV[Constants[b]]
      local gName = _CONST[b]
      _R[a] = _ENV[gName]
    elseif op == 58 then
      -- OP_SETGLOBAL: _ENV[Constants[b]] = R[a]
      _ENV[_CONST[b]] = _R[a]
    elseif op == 79 then
      -- OP_GETTABLE: R[a] = R[b][ R[c] or Constants[c] ]
      local tbl = _R[b]
      local key = inst[5] and _CONST[c] or _R[c]
      if tbl ~= nil then
        _R[a] = tbl[key]
      else
        _R[a] = nil
      end
    elseif op == 100 then
      -- OP_SETTABLE: R[a][ R[b] or Constants[b] ] = R[c]
      local tbl = _R[a]
      local key = inst[5] and _CONST[b] or _R[b]
      if tbl ~= nil then
        tbl[key] = _R[c]
      end
    elseif op == 24 then
      -- OP_CALL: R[a]( R[a+1] ... R[a+b-1] )
      local func = _R[a]
      local args = {}
      local argCount = b - 1
      if argCount == -1 then
        -- Variable arguments to top
        for i = a + 1, #_R do
          table.insert(args, _R[i])
        end
      else
        for i = 1, argCount do
          table.insert(args, _R[a + i])
        end
      end
      
      local rets = { func(unpack(args)) }
      local retCount = c - 1
      if retCount == -1 then
        for i = 1, #rets do
          _R[a + i - 1] = rets[i]
        end
      else
        for i = 1, retCount do
          _R[a + i - 1] = rets[i]
        end
      end
    elseif op == 30 then
      -- OP_MOVE: R[a] = R[b]
      _R[a] = _R[b]
    elseif op == 31 then
      -- OP_LOADNIL: R[a] = nil
      _R[a] = nil
    elseif op == 17 then
      -- OP_LOADBOOL: R[a] = (b == 1)
      _R[a] = (b == 1)
    elseif op == 80 then
      -- OP_NEWTABLE: R[a] = {}
      _R[a] = {}
    elseif op == 45 then
      _R[a] = _R[b] + (inst[5] and _CONST[c] or _R[c])
    elseif op == 87 then
      _R[a] = _R[b] - (inst[5] and _CONST[c] or _R[c])
    elseif op == 38 then
      _R[a] = _R[b] * (inst[5] and _CONST[c] or _R[c])
    elseif op == 73 then
      _R[a] = _R[b] / (inst[5] and _CONST[c] or _R[c])
    elseif op == 25 then
      local parts = {}
      for i = b, c do
        table.insert(parts, _R[i])
      end
      _R[a] = table.concat(parts)
    elseif op == 101 then
      _IP = _IP + b
    elseif op == 37 then
      if _R[a] then
        _IP = _IP + b
      end
    elseif op == 65 then
      if not _R[a] then
        _IP = _IP + b
      end
    elseif op == 72 then
      _R[a] = (_R[b] == (inst[5] and _CONST[c] or _R[c]))
    elseif op == 52 then
      local retCount = b - 1
      if retCount == 0 then
        return
      elseif retCount == 1 then
        return _R[a]
      else
        local rets = {}
        for i = 1, retCount do
          table.insert(rets, _R[a + i - 1])
        end
        return unpack(rets)
      end
    end
  end
end

-- [[ VM Execution Bootstrap ]]
do
  local _raw_unpack = {}
  local _k = _SEED_K
  local _len = #_DEC_BLOB
  local _bxor = (bit32 and bit32.bxor) or (bit and bit.bxor) or function(a, b)
    local p, c = 1, 0
    while a > 0 and b > 0 do
      local ra, rb = a % 2, b % 2
      if ra ~= rb then c = c + p end
      a, b, p = (a - ra) / 2, (b - rb) / 2, p * 2
    end
    while a > 0 do
      local ra = a % 2
      if ra > 0 then c = c + p end
      a, p = (a - ra) / 2, p * 2
    end
    return c
  end

  for i = 1, _len do
    local b = string.byte(_DEC_BLOB, i)
    _raw_unpack[i] = string.char(_bxor(b, _k) % 256)
    _k = (_k + _SEED_STEP) % 256
  end

  local _payload_src = table.concat(_raw_unpack)
  local _exec_fn, _err = (loadstring or load)(_payload_src, "@LuauShield_Protected_Binary")
  if not _exec_fn then
    error("[LuauShield]: Bytecode verification checksum failure: " .. tostring(_err))
  else
    local _success, _runtime_err = pcall(_exec_fn)
    if not _success then
      error("[LuauShield Runtime Error]: " .. tostring(_runtime_err))
    end
  end
end
